_comment: What packaging/build-deb.sh writes to usr/share/doc/llimit/copyright through
scripts/deb-copyright.py. Paths are relative to this file. $SWIFT_LICENSE,
$SWIFT_VERSION and $SWIFT_TAG come from the toolchain that built the binary.
The Swift static Linux SDK links these components into usr/bin/llimit;
notices.json lists the same set for Third-Party-Notices.txt and checks it
against the SDK's SBOM, and scripts/static-runtime-notices.py fails the build
if the binary links anything these files do not name.

components.name: Swift standard library, Foundation and libdispatch
copyright: Apple Inc. and the Swift project authors
components.comment: The static SDK's Swift runtime, swift-corelibs-foundation, swift-foundation and libdispatch. The Runtime Library Exception waives attribution; listed for completeness.

components.name: ICU
copyright: 2016 and later Unicode, Inc. and others
1995-2016 International Business Machines Corporation and others
components.comment: Foundation's ICU code and data, including the third-party dictionaries and time zone data whose terms are part of the license text. Not covered by the Swift Runtime Library Exception.

components.name: curl
components.comment: libcurl, for FoundationNetworking. Built from curl's git tag curl-8_7_1, so the binary reports libcurl/8.7.0-DEV.

components.name: BoringSSL
components.comment: TLS for libcurl. One upstream LICENSE file covers all three licenses.
